annotations.title: What's waiting for a decision in Compass

description: The Compass Inbox in one read: finished interviews awaiting review (transcript in, not yet turned into pages), AI-proposed opportunities awaiting accept / dismiss, and the caller's pending approval cards for Compass writes. THE place to answer 'what needs me?' for the map. Also `fillIn`: what the map is missing to say who's responsible for what (priorities with no owner, business units with no lead, people and roles in no unit, priorities with no workflow behind them); not counted in `total`. Next moves: compass_interviews_get to read a transcript, then propose pages from it with compass_pages_create; compass_opportunities_accept or compass_opportunities_delete for a proposal. For fillIn, ask the user who owns or leads it, or which unit someone sits in, then compass_links_create with kind owns (person or role → priority or unit) or part_of (person, role or unit → unit); never guess an owner.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.
